```{r read_CSSScores, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, class.source="foldable"}
#read csv check the structure and descriptive statistics 
CSSScores <- read.csv("data/df_scores_final.csv", sep=";")

head(CSSScores)
str(CSSScores)
summary(CSSScores)
colnames(CSSScores)
nrow(CSSScores)

#check the distribution of scores for each visit with boxplot
library(psych)
describe(CSSScores)
cols_obj <- grep("Scoreobj", colnames(CSSScores))

boxplot(CSSScores[, cols_obj],
        las = 2,
        main = "Objective scores",
        col = "lightgreen")
cols_subj <- grep("Scoresubj", colnames(CSSScores))

boxplot(CSSScores[, cols_subj],
        las = 2,
        main = "Subjective scores",
        col = "lightpink")
```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
#bland Altman for V1

#create mean and difference columns for V1
CSSScores$V1_mean <- (CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj + CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj)/2
CSSScores$V1_diff <- CSSScores$V1_Scoreobj - CSSScores$V1_Scoresubj

# Bias and SD of differences 
mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores$V1_diff, na.rm = TRUE)

# Limits of agreement
lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96*sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96*sd_diff

# Plot with ggplot
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(CSSScores, aes(x = V1_mean, y = V1_diff)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Bland-Altman Plot V1",
       x = "Score mean (Obj & Subj)",
       y = "Score difference (Obj - Subj)")
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
#check the normality of difference distribution for each visit
# loop for all visits
for (v in 1:20) {
  diff_col <- paste0("V", v, "_diff")
  
  # check if column exists (if some visits are missing)
  if(diff_col %in% colnames(CSSScores)) {
    
    # Shapiro-Wilk test
    shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(CSSScores[[diff_col]])
    print(shapiro_test)
    
    # QQ-plot
    qqnorm(CSSScores[[diff_col]], main = paste("QQ-plot Visit", v))
    qqline(CSSScores[[diff_col]], col = "red")
  }
}
```

```{r ba_each_visit, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, echo=TRUE}

#bland altman for each visit with plot instead of ggplot for html document

par(mfrow = c(4, 5))   

for (v in 1:20) {

  obj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoreobj")
  subj_col <- paste0("V", v, "_Scoresubj")
  mean_col <- paste0("V", v, "_mean")
  diff_col <- paste0("V", v, "_diff")
  
  CSSScores[[mean_col]] <- (CSSScores[[obj_col]] + CSSScores[[subj_col]]) / 2
  CSSScores[[diff_col]] <- CSSScores[[obj_col]] - CSSScores[[subj_col]]
  
  mean_diff <- mean(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_diff <- sd(CSSScores[[diff_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96 * sd_diff
  upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96 * sd_diff

  plot(
    CSSScores[[mean_col]],
    CSSScores[[diff_col]],
    main = paste("V", v),
    xlab = "Mean",
    ylab = "Diff",
    pch = 16
  )

  abline(h = mean_diff, col = "blue", lty = 2)
  abline(h = lower_limit, col = "red", lty = 2)
  abline(h = upper_limit, col = "red", lty = 2)
}

```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
# Transform CSSScores to long format for all visits combined
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

data_long <- CSSScores %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sid,
    names_to = c("Visit", "Type"),
    names_pattern = "V(\\d+)_(Scoreobj|Scoresubj)",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  
  # If there are multiple values per sid/Visit/Type, take the mean
  group_by(sid, Visit, Type) %>%
  summarise(Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Score) %>%
  mutate(
    mean = (Scoreobj + Scoresubj)/2,
    diff = Scoreobj - Scoresubj
  )
```



```{r, echo=TRUE}
#check the normality of difference distribution for all visits combined

# Shapiro-Wilk for all visits combined
shapiro_test_global <- shapiro.test(data_long$diff)
print(shapiro_test_global)

# QQ-plot for all visits combined
qqnorm(data_long$diff, main = "QQ-plot global differences")
qqline(data_long$diff, col = "red") 
```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
#Classic Bland Altman for all visits combined

library(ggplot2)

# Bias, SD of differences and limits of agreement for all visits combined
mean_diff <- mean(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff <- sd(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_limit <- mean_diff - 1.96 * sd_diff
upper_limit <- mean_diff + 1.96 * sd_diff

#bland altman plot for all visits combined
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-8, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Classic Bland-Altman for all visits combined",
    x = "Scores Mean (Obj & Subj)",
    y = "Scores differences (Obj - Subj)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}

library(MKinfer)

# Nonparametric Bland-Altman plot for all visits combined
baplot(

  y = data_long$Scoresubj,
  type = "nonparametric",
  xlab = "Mean score (objective and subjective)",
  ylab = "Score difference (objective - subjective)",
  title = "Nonparametric Bland-Altman Plot for all visits combined"
)
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
#Bland Altman with random effects for all visits combined
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Fit a mixed-effects model on the differences (random intercept per patient)
model_re <- lmer(diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid), data = data_long)

# Extract the fixed effect (overall mean difference = bias)
mean_diff_re <- fixef(model_re)[1]

# Extract variance components (between-subject and within-subject variability)
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_re))
var_between <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "sid"]
var_within <- attr(VarCorr(model_re), "sc")^2

# Compute total standard deviation
sd_total <- sqrt(var_between + var_within)

# Compute limits of agreement
lower_limit_re <- mean_diff_re - 1.96 * sd_total
upper_limit_re <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_total

# Plot Bland-Altman with random effects
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = mean, y = diff, color = sid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean_diff_re, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower_limit_re, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper_limit_re, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman Plot with Random Effects for all visits combined",
    x = "Mean score (objective and subjective)",
    y = "Score difference (objective - subjective)",
    color = "Patient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
upper_limit_re <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_total
```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
# Comparative table for all Bland-Altman methods
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)

# Initialize empty data frame to store results
ba_results <- data.frame(
  Method = character(),
  Bias = numeric(),
  Lower_LoA = numeric(),
  Upper_LoA = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 1. Classical Bland-Altman

mean_diff_classic <- mean(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff_classic <- sd(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_classic <- mean_diff_classic - 1.96 * sd_diff_classic
upper_classic <- mean_diff_classic + 1.96 * sd_diff_classic

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Classical (parametric)",
    Bias = mean_diff_classic,
    Lower_LoA = lower_classic,
    Upper_LoA = upper_classic
  )


# 2. Nonparametric Bland-Altman

# Compute median and 2.5% - 97.5% percentiles manually
median_diff <- median(data_long$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_np <- quantile(data_long$diff, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_np <- quantile(data_long$diff, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Nonparametric",
    Bias = median_diff,
    Lower_LoA = lower_np,
    Upper_LoA = upper_np
  )


# 3. Bland-Altman with Random Effects

# Mixed-effects model on diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid)
model_re <- lmer(diff ~ 1 + (1 | sid), data = data_long)
mean_diff_re <- fixef(model_re)[1]
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_re))
var_between <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "sid"]
var_within <- attr(VarCorr(model_re), "sc")^2
sd_total <- sqrt(var_between + var_within)
lower_re <- mean_diff_re - 1.96 * sd_total
upper_re <- mean_diff_re + 1.96 * sd_total

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Random Effects",
    Bias = mean_diff_re,
    Lower_LoA = lower_re,
    Upper_LoA = upper_re
  )


# 4. Bland-Altman without Outliers

Q1 <- quantile(data_long$diff, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(data_long$diff, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val

data_no_outliers <- data_long %>%
  filter(diff >= lower_bound & diff <= upper_bound)

mean_diff_no <- mean(data_no_outliers$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_diff_no <- sd(data_no_outliers$diff, na.rm = TRUE)
lower_no <- mean_diff_no - 1.96 * sd_diff_no
upper_no <- mean_diff_no + 1.96 * sd_diff_no

ba_results <- ba_results %>%
  add_row(
    Method = "Without Outliers",
    Bias = mean_diff_no,
    Lower_LoA = lower_no,
    Upper_LoA = upper_no
  )


# Display comparative table

ba_results %>% 
  arrange(Method)
```
